title: Bailable
summary: BA'ILABLE, adjective That may be set free upon bond with sureties; that may be admitted to bail; used of persons. 2. That admits of bail; as a bailable offense.

inlines.v: BA'ILABLE, adjective That may be set free upon bond with sureties; that may be admitted to bail; used of persons. 2. That admits of bail; as a bailable offense.
